Definition: from G303 and a derivative of the base of G3717; to straighten up:--lift (set) up, make straight.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus lifts up the woman bowed together for eighteen years, and the writer of Hebrews tells his readers to lift up the hands which hang down. The word is the straightening of what was bent.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for straightening what was bent carries no doctrine of its own; its beauty is the bent woman's, that Jesus sets straight what eighteen years had bowed.
